description: First-party API for Inception's Mercury diffusion language models, with OpenAI-compatible chat plus dedicated FIM and next-edit endpoints.
residency_notes: Inception's public terms and training opt-out language do not specify an API execution/storage region or a Zero Data Retention control; the training setting should not be treated as a retention guarantee.
prompt_training_notes: Inception says it may use user submissions to train its models, and API Platform users can opt out by turning off 'Improve the model for everyone' in settings.
